ana: Quick sync request 2: Orion needs a compact observability surface for Dedicated: per-route cost estimates, a lightweight trace hook, and simple error alerts. They want something demoable next week.

mike: Clarify scope: exact fields for "per-route cost"? hourly, per-token, include infra overhead?

ana: Minimal fields: route id, model, est cost/hour, est cost/100k tokens. No deep allocation for infra in alpha.

sophia: UX constraints: keep clicks low. In-line cost in route table + tiny "traces" icon that opens recent spans. Phase 2 can add time series.

jeff: Ops constraints: full-span retention is heavy. Proposal: capture span metadata (service, op, duration, error flag) and store full payload only if user expands. Estimate for Orion at 1% sampling ~20GB/week.

mike: Backend plan: cost-aggregator job that emits hourly rolls with route tags; traces: sampler + metadata pipeline + on-demand fetch. API schema draft by Mon.

sophia: Acceptance criteria (alpha): 1) cost table filterable by model/team; 2) sampling toggle per-customer; 3) recent spans modal with metadata + "fetch full"; 4) alert rule template (error rate > X). RBAC + audit in place.

ana: Canary plan: enable for 10% traffic for 24h, guard rails: trace-ingest backlog <30m, cost delta vs billing <5%. Rollback to aggregated-only if violated.

jeff: Will attach storage/cost numbers and encryption checklist to RED-5010.

mike: Rough alpha estimate: 2.5 dev-weeks + 0.5 SRE week. OK to prioritize for Orion if sales confirms timeline.

sophia: I'll produce two tiny mocks (route list with inline cost + modal) by Tue morning.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-5010: "Orion compact observability: per-route econ + trace hooks (alpha)"  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-5010

ana: Great. @mike please send the API sketch; I'll prep the one-pager for sales.
